# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `jobber` MCP server pointing at Jobber's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.getjobber.com/mcp`), with `"placement": "server"` so Grok Bot dials it through the hosted MCP path.
- Auth is OAuth with Jobber user login — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Jobber's official brandmark in white on a Jobber green (`#7DB00E`) 192×192 tile.
